data.name: Matthew
data.gender_notes: Matthew is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Matthew is recorded in name-lists as “Gift of God”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Matthew expresses “Gift of God”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matthew total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
data.cultural_impact: Matthew is used in Hebrew naming tradition with the meaning “Gift of God”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Matthew is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Gift of God” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Matthew; such symbolism is interpretive.
